title: Inspect Dopemux Init Registry Contract
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Inspect actual dopemux init/workspace identity behavior and formalize the project registry validation contract without implementing the facade.
why_this_packet_exists_now: Multi-project support depends on proving how a Dopemux-initialized workspace is identified. Guessing markers would be a tiny elegant bear trap.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Static inspection of dopemux init, workspace validation, project/workspace config, and .dopemux marker usage.
Document observed init markers and unknowns.
out: No changes to dopemux init behavior.

invariants: Marker contract must be OBSERVED or UNKNOWN.
plan: Search for dopemux init implementation, workspace validation, marker files, registry config, and project_id usage.
Trace active CLI entrypoint and command registration enough to locate init or confirm UNKNOWN.
Identify marker files and config fields used to prove a workspace is initialized.
Identify whether dopemux already has a project registry or list command.
Update registry contract with OBSERVED marker rules or explicit UNKNOWN sections.
Document validation algorithm for registry entry verification.
Record contradictions and stop if multiple incompatible marker contracts exist.
Run doc validation and diff inspection.
exact_commands: rg -n "dopemux init|def init|@.*init|workspace_id|workspace_root|repo_root|\.dopemux|project_id|repo_marker|validate.*workspace|resolve.*workspace|projects list|list_projects|registry" src services docs tests pyproject.toml
rg -n "\.dopemux|dopemux.toml|workspace|init" README.md PROJECT.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md docs/03-reference -S || true
validation_gates: Observed init markers are documented with exact paths and code references, or marked UNKNOWN.
Registry contract no longer depends on invented marker assumptions.
Multi-project resolver algorithm is explicit and fail-closed.
proof_requirements: AUDIT.md challenging init marker findings and project registry assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Dopemux init identity contract is documented.
Registry schema is ready for implementation in 0004.
rollback_steps: Revert docs modified by this packet.
stop_conditions: No init/workspace identity code can be found.
Multiple conflicting marker contracts require supervisor decision.
Any validation would require mutating a workspace.
Generated docs would need to reveal local secrets or private paths.

auditor_focus: Does the registry contract fail closed?

commit.message: docs(dcp): formalize dopemux init registry contract
verify: rg -n "\.dopemux|dopemux.toml|workspace|init" README.md PROJECT.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md docs/03-reference -S || true
